purpose: Source identity + lineage inputs for the Koenji Cultural Signal Lens (/atlas/). Source lineage only; no cultural or historical-location claim.

acquisition.note: The build environment cannot reach geospatial.jp / plateauview hosts. HQ downloaded the official package, extracted the two Koenji meshes and handed the raw CityGML files over unchanged. No network request is made by any tool in this directory.

api_endpoint: none (offline handoff; no PLATEAU API call from the build environment)

extraction.method: Python 3 stdlib xml.etree.iterparse; Building → bldg:lod0RoofEdge polygons + bldg:measuredHeight; Road → tran:lod1MultiSurface polygons; EPSG:6697 posList (lat lon height) → GeoJSON [lon, lat], height dropped; coordinates rounded to 6 decimals; no clipping / simplification / synthetic geometry; feature id = source gml:id
extraction.bbox_note: Present-day viewing window (~497 m × 433 m) around the Koenji station structures and the streets south of them, chosen for the Koenji Thread. It is NOT a historical boundary and does not locate any 1957–1963 event.
extraction.selection_rule: a feature is kept when its bbox intersects the crop bbox; kept features are stored whole
extraction.measured_height_sentinel: PLATEAU -9999 (unmeasured) and non-positive values are stored as null
